name: Jackett
description: API Support for your favorite torrent trackers

ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Password to protect the Jackett web dashboard.

API_KEY.description: API Key for accessing Jackett API. Automatically generated if left blank.

BASE_PATH.description: Base path override for reverse proxy setups (e.g., /jackett).

INDEXER_CONFIGS_BASE64.description: Base64-encoded tar.gz or zip archive containing indexer configuration files.

CONFIG_URL.description: HTTPS URL pointing to a tar.gz or zip archive containing indexer configuration files.
